documents.text: The PSFCH channel in NR V2X sidelink is used to transmit sidelink HARQ feedback for unicast and groupcast services. It provides feedback on the success or failure of the whole transport block and triggers for channel state information (CSI) feedback.

documents.title: When a successful association request is issued, the access point responds with
documents.text: When a successful association request is issued, the access point responds with a status code of 0 (successful) and the Association ID (AID).

documents.text: MulteFire uses Block Interleaved FDMA (B-IFDMA) as the UL transmission scheme.

documents.text: The document states that the key difference in Digital Twin-based systems compared to existing network simulation and planning tools is that they are connected to deployed physical subsystems and the whole system evolves as the deployment proceeds.

documents.text: EC-GSM-IoT improves the coverage performance of Cellular IoT devices by using modified channel coding schemes.

documents.text: The Relaxed monitoring for cell reselection feature allows the UE to avoid monitoring neighbouring cells for 24 hours in cases where the UE is stationary and/or the network topology is not changing. This helps to extend UE battery life.

documents.text: The Radio Network Information Service (RNIS) provides actual RAN information relating to the User Equipments (UEs) in the network.

documents.text: The Header Checksum is a check value used to validate the IP header.

documents.text: Spread spectrum technology is used in unlicensed devices to diffuse signal power over a large range of frequencies, making transmissions look like noise to narrowband receivers.

documents.text: The UE Capability Management Function (UCMF) is used to store, assign, and provision UE radio capability IDs.

documents.text: The Load-Balancing steering mode splits the traffic of a data flow across 3GPP and non-3GPP accesses in both uplink and downlink directions separately.

documents.text: The intent driven management aims to reduce the complexity of management without getting into the intricate detail of the underlying network resources.

documents.text: The Window field in the TCP header indicates the maximum number of data bytes that can be sent before a confirmation is sent and received.

documents.text: The TYPE(TAG) and VLAN TPID fields in an IEEE802.1Q tagged frame specify the VLAN identification.

documents.text: The IEEE 802.3ad standard describes the use of the LACP (Link Aggregation Control Protocol) for easy exchange of configuration information between the various systems.

documents.text: The MAC sublayer in Ethernet is responsible for accessing the network using the CSMA/CD access mechanism and detecting collisions.

documents.text: The EAS discovery specifies the requirements for providing mechanisms for an EEC to discover available EASs.

documents.text: 3GPP TS 28.104 specifies that various consumers, including MnFs, NFs, SON functions, SLS assurance functions, human operators, and AFs, can consume MDAS.

documents.text: The three-way handshake is used to establish a reliable connection between two hosts or participants.

documents.text: The purpose of the Common API Framework (CAPIF) for 3GPP Northbound APIs is to define a standard API framework for 3rd party Application Servers.

documents.text: The Challenge Text in the third frame of a shared-key authentication exchange contains 128 bytes generated using the WEP keystream generator.

documents.text: While address filtering is better than nothing, it can easily be overridden by an attacker wishing to gain network access. MAC addresses are generally software- or firmware-programmable and can be easily changed.

documents.title: In the context of integration with IEEE TSN network, 5GS acts as
documents.text: In the context of integration with IEEE TSN network, 5GS acts as a Layer 2 Ethernet Bridge.

documents.title: In order to indicate its intent to change power management modes, a
documents.text: In order to indicate its intent to change power management modes, a STA shall transmit individually addressed or group addressed (QoS) Null frames within the ATIM window.

documents.title: Purpose of DNS
documents.text: DNS provides a solution to the problem of establishing a link between host names and IP addresses by translating host names to IP addresses and vice versa.

documents.title: Purpose of the map-based hybrid channel model
documents.text: The map-based hybrid channel model is used to evaluate or predict system performance by taking into account the impacts from environmental structures and materials using a digital map.

documents.title: Purpose of an auto-polarity circuit in a Powered Device (PD) in a PoE system
documents.text: An auto-polarity circuit in a Powered Device (PD) in a PoE system helps prevent errors related to polarity.

documents.text: The interference between UL transmission in one cell and DL reception in another cell is referred to as Cross Link Interference (CLI).

documents.title: Above 100 kHz, the effect associated with exposure to CW fields transitions
documents.text: Above 100 kHz, the effect associated with exposure to CW fields transitions from electrostimulation to tissue heating.

documents.text: 3GPP TS 33.501 specifies that keys KNASint and KNASenc are derived from KAMF for the protection of NAS signaling.

documents.text: According to the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) regulations, if a radar signal is detected, the non-occupancy period must be 30 minutes.

documents.title: The ability of a network to maintain an acceptable level of service in the event of various faults and challenges to normal operation called
documents.text: The document states that the ability of a network to maintain an acceptable level of service in the event of various faults and challenges to normal operation is called resilience.

documents.text: The NWDAF collects information from the UPF via SMF (Session Management Function).

documents.text: The fragment offset field in an IP packet specifies the position of the fragment in the total message.

documents.text: A safety program is an organized system of policies, procedures, practices, and plans designed to help ensure compliance with exposure limits associated with electric, magnetic, and electromagnetic fields.

documents.title: Purpose of inter-network settlement mechanisms
documents.text: The purpose of inter-network settlement mechanisms is to determine payments between parties on a periodic basis.

documents.title: Purpose of the traceroute command
documents.text: The traceroute command is used to display the IP addresses of the routers that receive test packets and return them, showing the route to a certain host.

documents.title: The key information used by the T-ADS mechanism is the time stamp
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.292 specifies that the key information used by the T-ADS mechanism is the time stamp at which the UE attached to a given access network. More precisely, this Work Item introduces two time stamp values: the one of the most recent IMS registration or re-registration via WLAN, and the one of the 3GPP access network that had the most recent radio contact with the UE.

documents.title: The main difference between 802.11 and Ethernet
documents.text: One of the main differences between 802.11 and Ethernet is that 802.11 uses collision avoidance (CSMA/CA) while Ethernet uses collision detection (CSMA/CD).

documents.text: QCI-1 in LTE represents real-time interactive traffic.

documents.title: The reduction of the maximum number of data radio bearers (DRBs) that a RedCap (reduced capability) device must mandatorily support
documents.text: The reduction in the maximum number of data radio bearers (DRBs) that a RedCap device must mandatorily support is from 16 to 8.

documents.text: The physical control format indicator channel (PCFICH) informs the UE and the RN about the number of OFDM symbols used for the PDCCHs.

documents.text: Uplink buffer status reports are used to provide support for QoS-aware packet scheduling in the uplink.

documents.title: Purpose of the ePWS feature
documents.text: The ePWS feature enhances the Public Warning System by defining behaviours for UEs with no user interface or with a user interface that is incapable of displaying text-based Warning Notifications and providing how to improve the comprehension of a Warning Notification to users with disabilities who have UEs supporting assistive technologies beyond text assistive technologies and users who are not fluent in the language of the Warning Notifications.

documents.title: The main role of the DeNB in the mobility of a UE to or from an RN
documents.text: The DeNB triggers the S1 or X2 handover procedure for the UE moving to or from an RN.

documents.title: Purpose of MRP in a network
documents.text: MRP is a protocol that aims to provide redundancy and quick recovery in case of network errors.

documents.title: The meaning of the ESS/IBSS bits in the Capability Information field
documents.text: The ESS/IBSS bits in the Capability Information field are used to indicate whether the access point is part of an infrastructure network or an IBSS.

documents.title: Positioning techniques are supported in the NR positioning work item
documents.text: The NR positioning work item supports DL TDOA, DL AoD, UL TDOA, UL AoA (Azimuth and Zenith), Multi-RTT, and NR E-CID positioning techniques.

documents.title: The UE should check the access Class or ACDC category related cell
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.331 specifies that the UE should check the access Class or ACDC category related cell access restrictions and proceed accordingly.

documents.text: One of the main features of 3GPP Rel-14 is the introduction of enhanced-Licensed Assisted Access (eLAA).

documents.text: Based on histopathological analysis, testicular and brain tissues appear to be the most sensitive to thermal insult for exposures of short duration.

documents.title: Some potential attacks that UAVs are vulnerable to in wireless communications
documents.text: UAVs in wireless communications are vulnerable to attacks such as unauthorized access and control, eavesdropping of data, jamming of signals, and location and identity spoofing attacks.

documents.text: The purpose of the Service Enabler Architecture Layer (SEAL) for Verticals is to define common capabilities for mission critical services and applications.

documents.text: When both transmitting STA and receiving STA indicate OBSS mitigation support, the receiving STA can set the TXVECTOR parameter CH_BANDWIDTH to indicate a channel width that is the same as or lower than the RXVECTOR parameter CH_BANDWIDTH of the frame eliciting the response.

documents.text: The Make-Before-Break solution is designed to reduce the mobility interruption time by keeping the source connection after the reception of the handover/SeNB change command and before the first transmission/reception on the target cell.

documents.text: Access points provide distribution and integration services to extend services from the wired network to the wireless network.

documents.text: The evaluation results show that ARP errors can have a significant impact on NR carrier phase positioning accuracy.

documents.text: The extended sensors use case in NR-V2X aims to exchange sensor data among vehicles, pedestrians, and other road users to provide a holistic view of the environment in each vehicle, enhancing perception, planning, and control in road users.

documents.text: The key functionality introduced for prioritization between overlapping uplink resources of one UE in the 5G Core network is support for prioritization between overlapping uplink resources of one UE.

documents.text: Spreading is applied in PUCCH formats 3 and 4 to enhance the orthogonality of the transmitted symbols. This helps to reduce the inter-UE interference and improve the reliability of the PUCCH transmission.

documents.text: The Physical Sidelink Feedback Channel (PSFCH) is used to transmit the HARQ feedback from a receiver UE to the transmitter UE in NR-V2X.

documents.text: The purpose of the Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) is to guarantee a closed loop-free LAN and provide an automated backup path if an active link drops out.

documents.title: The energy penetration depth into the skin decreases monotonically with increasing frequency

documents.text: Orthogonal hopping sequences help minimize interference between multiple 802.11 networks in a single area, thus maximizing throughput.

documents.text: The RA frame signals the presence of downlink buffered data for paged STAs and their assigned RAW slots for both uplink and downlink service periods.

documents.text: The Ga reference point allows the sending of CDRs from the CDF to the CGF.

documents.title: Purpose of UE radio capability signalling optimization
documents.text: The purpose of UE radio capability signalling optimization is to have an efficient approach to signal UE radio capability information.

documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.401 specifies that the enhancement of the Dedicated Core Networks selection mechanism introduced the functionalities of reliance on UE-assisted DCN selection and load balancing between MMEs.

documents.text: When the Analytics target period is in the future, the NWDAF detects the need for notification about a potential QoS change based on comparing the expected values for the KPI of the target 5QI against the Reporting Threshold(s) and provides predictions for potential QoS changes in the response or notification on 'QoS Sustainability'.

documents.text: The Physical Layer of the OSI model provides the mechanical, electrical or optical entities required to realize a physical connection.

documents.text: CS-RNTI is used for Semi-Persistent Scheduling in the downlink or configured grant in the uplink.

documents.text: In 10/100Base-T, pair 2 (orange/white and orange) and pair 3 (green/white and green) are used.

documents.text: The LECIM DSSS PHY operates with characteristics that enable support of LECIM applications.

documents.text: The gNB-CU sends the UE CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message to establish the UE context in the gNB-DU.

documents.text: The Channel Width subfield in the VHT MIMO Control field indicates the width of the channel in which the measurement to create the compressed beamforming feedback matrix was made.

documents.text: The gNB always requests the UE UTRA-FDD capabilities before handover to UTRA-FDD.

documents.title: In the case of event based charging without reservation, if the OCS
documents.text: 3GPP TS 32.240 specifies that in the case of event based charging without reservation, if the OCS rejects the resource usage request, the NE disallows the resource usage.

documents.title: Purpose of the work item on Enhanced LAA for LTE
documents.text: The purpose of the work item on Enhanced LAA for LTE is to enable operation of an LAA SCell on the UL in unlicensed spectrum by specifying UL carrier aggregation for LAA SCell(s) including channel access mechanisms, core and RF requirements for base stations and UEs, and RRM requirements.

documents.title: The UTP cable used in 10/100Base-T consists of 8 wires arranged in
documents.text: The UTP cable used in 10/100Base-T consists of 8 wires arranged in 4 pairs.

documents.title: Purpose of Discontinuous Reception (DRX) in idle mode
documents.text: DRX is used in idle mode to reduce power consumption by allowing the UE to periodically turn off its receiver and conserve energy.

documents.title: Technology can be used for the connection between the Evolved ProSe Remote UE and the Evolved ProSe UE-to-Network Relay
documents.text: The connection between the Evolved ProSe Remote UE and the Evolved ProSe UE-to-Network Relay can use both E-UTRA and WLAN.

documents.title: Some of the key performance indicators used to characterize the quality of positioning information for vehicle-to-everything scenarios
documents.text: The key performance indicators for positioning information in vehicle-to-everything scenarios include positioning accuracy, latency, update rate, and reliability.

documents.title: The time constant for a person standing on a ground plane with a resistance of 1000 MΩ and a capacitance of 150 pF
documents.text: A person standing on a ground plane with a resistance of 1000 MΩ and a capacitance of 150 pF has a time constant of 150 ms.

documents.title: Schedulers in MAC in gNB assign resources between UEs based on their
documents.text: Schedulers in MAC in gNB assign resources between UEs based on their buffer status and QoS requirements.

documents.title: The supported sidelink resource allocation modes
documents.text: The two supported sidelink resource allocation modes are mode 1 and mode 2.

documents.title: Mechanism is specifically designed to avoid interference with non-IMT systems
documents.text: Dynamic Frequency Selection (DFS) is specifically designed to avoid interference with non-IMT systems.

documents.title: The advantage of RF-based imaging compared to optical cameras
documents.text: RF signals are less impacted by weather and ambient light compared to optical cameras.

documents.title: Purpose of the SGNB ADDITION REQUEST message
documents.text: The SGNB ADDITION REQUEST message is used to request the creation of a UE context.

documents.title: Purpose of the periodic CSI-RS resource configuration indexes
documents.text: The periodic CSI-RS resource configuration indexes are used by the UE to perform radio link quality measurements on the BWP of the serving cell.

documents.title: The areas covered in the eV2X work of Rel-15 to enhance 3GPP support for V2X scenarios
documents.text: The eV2X work of Rel-15 covers vehicle platooning, advanced driving, extended sensors, and remote driving to enhance the 3GPP support for V2X scenarios.

documents.title: Bluetooth uses Adaptive Frequency Hopping (AFH) mechanism to avoid interference with WLAN
documents.text: Bluetooth uses Adaptive Frequency Hopping (AFH) mechanism to avoid interference with WLAN.

documents.title: Purpose of local breakout in the Evolved Packet System
documents.text: Local breakout allows routing to be optimized so that user plane traffic does not need to leave the current region.

documents.title: The document states that the O-DU (Open-DU) is the distributed unit that
documents.text: The document states that the O-DU (Open-DU) is the distributed unit that sits close to the radio unit and runs the Radio Link Control (RLC), Medium Access Control (MAC), and parts of the Physical (PHY) layer.

documents.title: Purpose of timing resiliency in a 5G system
documents.text: Timing resiliency enhances the 5G system to act as a backup for loss of GNSS references.

documents.title: TCP/IP
documents.text: TCP/IP is a collection of industrial standard protocols designed for communication over large networks and is used on the internet.

documents.title: Purpose of Extended Access Barring
documents.text: The purpose of Extended Access Barring is to prevent overload of the access network and/or the core network.

documents.title: When the UE applies zero value for a timer, the timer shall
documents.text: When the UE applies zero value for a timer, the timer shall be started and immediately expire unless explicitly stated otherwise.

documents.title: Purpose of resending datagrams in TCP to achieve reliability
documents.text: Resending datagrams in TCP helps guarantee that the receiver receives the data by retransmitting it if an acknowledgement is not received within a specific timeframe.

documents.title: Purpose of the 'Fragmentation required' message sent by a router
documents.text: The 'Fragmentation required' message is sent by a router to inform the source host that the IP packet is greater than the Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) of the network it needs to be sent over.

documents.title: Bluetooth uses Frequency Hopping Spread Spectrum (FHSS) technology to transmit data
documents.text: Bluetooth uses Frequency Hopping Spread Spectrum (FHSS) technology to transmit data.

documents.title: Each EDCAF should report an internal collision if there is a frame
documents.text: Each EDCAF should report an internal collision if there is a frame available for transmission at that EDCAF and the backoff counter for that EDCAF has a value of 0.

documents.title: Purpose of Real-Time Text conversation
documents.text: Real-Time Text (RTT) conversation is a service enabled in 3GPP networks by the Global Text Telephony ( GTT ).

documents.title: The frequency range for VHF (Very High Frequency)
documents.text: VHF (Very High Frequency) has a frequency range of 30 MHz to 300 MHz.

documents.title: The two states defined for the LTE-U SC
documents.text: The LTE-U SC has two states: Off-State and On-State.

documents.title: The averaging times used in the IEEE C95.1-series standards for exposures in restricted and unrestricted environments
documents.text: The IEEE C95.1-series standards use a 6-minute averaging time for exposures in restricted environments and a 30-minute averaging time for exposures in unrestricted environments.

documents.title: The advantage of DQPSK over DBPSK
documents.text: Differential quadrature phase shift keying (DQPSK) has a higher throughput compared to differential binary phase shift keying (DBPSK).

documents.title: Pair of wires is connected to pin 3 and pin 6 in the 10/100Base-T connector
documents.text: Pair 3 (green/white and green) is connected to pin 3 and pin 6.

documents.title: 3GPP release introduced Device to Device (D2D) communication
documents.text: D2D communication was introduced in LTE-advanced (Rel-12).

documents.title: IEEE standard introduced the 10Base-T technology
documents.text: The IEEE802.3i standard introduced the 10Base-T technology.

documents.title: Purpose of the UEAssistanceInformationSidelink message
documents.text: The purpose of the UEAssistanceInformationSidelink message is to include sidelink DRX assistance information used to determine the sidelink DRX configuration.

documents.title: The 3GPP standard should enable deployment of RedCap in all frequency division
documents.text: The 3GPP standard should enable deployment of RedCap in all frequency division duplex (FDD) and time division duplex (TDD) bands in frequency range 1 (FR1), which ranges from 0.4 to 7.1 GHz.

documents.title: The safety factor for protection against thermal pain in skin above 6 GHz
documents.text: The safety factor for protection against thermal pain in skin above 6 GHz is 2 to 5.

documents.title: The measure of modulation quality for NB-IoT
documents.text: The EVM of each NB-IoT carrier on NB-PDSCH shall be better than the limits in Table 6.5.2-2, which is a measure of the difference between the ideal symbols and the measured symbols after the equalization.

documents.title: The UDM notifies the affected AMF by invoking the Nudm_SDM_Notification service operation
documents.text: The UDM notifies the affected AMF by invoking the Nudm_SDM_Notification service operation.

documents.title: Purpose of the Access Traffic Steering, Switching and Splitting (ATSS) feature in 5G networks
documents.text: The ATSS feature enables the establishment of a Multi Access (MA) PDU Session, which supports multipath data communication between the UE and UPF.

documents.title: MCCH transmissions and the associated radio resources and MCS are indicated to
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.331 specifies that MCCH transmissions and the associated radio resources and MCS are indicated to the UE via the PDCCH addressed to MCCH-RNTI.

documents.title: Message is used for the indication of measurement results of NR sidelink
documents.text: The MeasurementReportSidelink message is used for the indication of measurement results of NR sidelink.

documents.title: Purpose of the Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF)
documents.text: The purpose of the Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF) is to support network automation.

documents.title: Purpose of the Evolution to and Interworking with eCall in IMS work item
documents.text: The Evolution to and Interworking with eCall in IMS work item introduces the support of end-to-end eCall over IMS.

documents.title: The two modes of resource allocation in NR SL (Sidelink)
documents.text: The two modes of resource allocation in NR SL are Mode 1 and Mode 2.

documents.title: A requirement for ProSe Discovery to determine whether other ProSe-enabled UEs are of interest to a discovering ProSe-enabled UE
documents.text: For ProSe Discovery, determining whether other ProSe-enabled UEs are of interest to a discovering ProSe-enabled UE requires authorisation from the operator.

documents.title: Definition of NWDAF
documents.text: NWDAF stands for Network Data Analytics Function.

documents.title: The full form of NFV
documents.text: NFV stands for Network Function Virtualization.

documents.title: Purpose of the QFI in the downlink
documents.text: The QFI is signalled in the downlink for the purpose of RQoS to indicate QoS flow mapping.

documents.title: Port number is associated with Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTPS)
documents.text: The port number 443 is associated with HTTPS.

documents.title: Purpose of autocrossing in current Ethernet ports
documents.text: Autocrossing in current Ethernet ports allows the detection of the cable used and the internal correction of any crossing errors.

documents.title: Purpose of scanning in the context of 802.11 networks
documents.text: Scanning is the process of identifying existing networks in the area before joining them.

documents.title: Security procedure is used for RRC and UP security algorithms negotiation and RRC security activation
documents.text: 3GPP TS 33.501 specifies that the AS SMC procedure is used for RRC and UP security algorithms negotiation and RRC security activation.

documents.title: Purpose of the interworking gateway
documents.text: The interworking gateway enables interactions between SBA NFV-MANO and non-SBA NFV-MANO systems.

documents.title: Position accuracy can be achieved using carrier phase measurements in NR carrier phase positioning
documents.text: The evaluation results show that, in certain scenarios and conditions, the use of carrier phase measurements in NR carrier phase positioning can achieve centimeter-level positioning accuracy.

documents.title: TSGs are responsible for the definition, development, and maintenance of the overall system architecture and service capabilities
documents.text: SA TSGs are responsible for the definition, development, and maintenance of the overall system architecture and service capabilities.

documents.title: The ChannelAccess-CPext field in Type-2 random access procedure for operation with shared
documents.text: 3GPP TS 38.213 specifies that the ChannelAccess-CPext field in Type-2 random access procedure for operation with shared spectrum channel access in FR1 indicates the channel access type.

documents.title: In a non-DMG STA, MSDUs or A-MSDUs stored in the buffer should
documents.text: In a non-DMG STA, MSDUs or A-MSDUs stored in the buffer should be passed up to the next MAC process in order of increasing value of the Sequence Number subfield starting with WinStartB and proceeding sequentially until there is no buffered MSDU or A-MSDU for the next sequential Sequence Number subfield value.

documents.title: The TWT wake interval in a TWT element transmitted by a TWT
documents.text: The TWT wake interval in a TWT element transmitted by a TWT requesting STA is equal to the average time that the TWT requesting STA expects to elapse between successive TWT SPs.

documents.title: The IEEE802.3af Power over Ethernet standard allows for the common transmission of
documents.text: The IEEE802.3af Power over Ethernet standard allows for the common transmission of data and power over the same Ethernet cable.

documents.title: The drawback of using address filtering as a security measure
documents.text: Address filtering based on MAC addresses can be overridden by an attacker wishing to gain network access.

documents.title: Purpose of the charging extensions in the feature related to WLAN access in EPC
documents.text: The purpose of the charging extensions in the feature related to WLAN access in EPC is to identify and charge for traffic transported over unlicensed access.

documents.title: Higher layer is responsible for transferring the PC5-RRC message between UEs (User Equipments) in NR SL
documents.text: Sidelink RRC is responsible for transferring the PC5-RRC message between UEs in NR SL.

documents.title: Protocol belongs to the application layer of the TCP/IP suite
documents.text: The HTTP protocol belongs to the application layer of the TCP/IP suite.

documents.title: 802.11 uses collision avoidance (CSMA/CA) instead of collision detection (CSMA/CD)
documents.text: 802.11 uses collision avoidance (CSMA/CA) instead of collision detection (CSMA/CD).

documents.title: Another term for Link Aggregation
documents.text: Another term for Link Aggregation is Trunking.

documents.title: Beacon frames on frequency-hopping networks include the necessary information for a station
documents.text: Beacon frames on frequency-hopping networks include the necessary information for a station to synchronize its hopping pattern.

documents.title: The IHL field represents the length of the header in bytes
documents.text: The IHL field represents the length of the header in bytes.

documents.title: The types of analytics that the NF can request in the Nnwdaf_AnalyticsSubscription_Subscribe Request
documents.text: The NF can request both statistics and predictions in the Nnwdaf_AnalyticsSubscription_Subscribe Request.

documents.title: Purpose of the Flow label in the IPv6 header
documents.text: The Flow label is a 20-bit identification number used to distinguish a packet in a data stream.

documents.title: The function of NTP
documents.text: NTP (Network Time Protocol) allows computers to synchronize their internal clocks with another computer, ensuring accurate timekeeping.

documents.title: Authentication method requires both stations to implement WEP
documents.text: Shared-key authentication is based on WEP and requires that both stations implement WEP.

documents.title: Architecture combines SDN (such as software-defined networking) and NFV characteristics and consists of entities such as the Network Management System (NMS), the Network Function Virtualization Infrastructure (NFVI), and the Operation/Business Support Scheme (OSS/BSS)
documents.text: The ETSI SDN-NFV MANO architecture combines SDN and NFV characteristics and consists of entities such as the NMS, NFVI, and OSS/BSS.

documents.title: Purpose of Ethernet Header Compression (EHC) in the support of NR Industrial Internet of Things
documents.text: The purpose of Ethernet Header Compression (EHC) in the support of NR Industrial Internet of Things is to increase the efficiency of Ethernet frames transmission over the NR air interface.

documents.title: Channel carries the Master Information Block (MIB) for SL in NR-V2X
documents.text: The Master Information Block (MIB) for SL in NR-V2X is carried by the Physical Sidelink Broadcast Channel (PSBCH).

documents.title: Purpose of the almost-blank subframe (ABS) feature in LTE Rel-10
documents.text: The ABS feature allows LTE base stations to transmit subframes containing basic system information messages for better coordination.

documents.title: The definition of OTA Adjacent Channel Leakage Power Ratio (ACLR)
documents.text: OTA Adjacent Channel Leakage power Ratio (ACLR) is the ratio of the filtered mean power centered on the assigned channel frequency to the filtered mean power centered on an adjacent channel frequency.

documents.title: When a cell is in energy saving state, all traffic on that
documents.text: When a cell is in energy saving state, all traffic on that cell is expected to be drained to other overlaid/umbrella candidate cells before the cell moves to energySaving state.

documents.title: Purpose of a CTS frame
documents.text: A CTS frame is used to answer the RTS frame.

documents.title: The two approaches for performing multi-antenna processing in a CF (Cell-free) mMIMO (massive multiple-input-multiple-output) network
documents.text: Precoding/combining operations can be performed locally at each AP or centrally at the CPU.

documents.title: Purpose of the DMaaP (Data movement as a platform)
documents.text: The document describes DMaaP as a premier platform for high performing and cost-effective data movement services that transport and process data from any source to any target with the format, quality, security, and concurrency.

documents.title: A collision domain
documents.text: A collision domain is a segment where a collision will occur when 2 participants send a data frame at the same time.

documents.title: Specification defines Lawful Interception functionality
documents.text: The definition and functionality of Lawful Interception are described in TS 33.126.

documents.title: The fragments of a single MSDU or MMPDU are sent as a
documents.text: The fragments of a single MSDU or MMPDU are sent as a burst in an EDCA or HCCA TXOP, subject to TXOP limits and medium occupancy limits for the attached PHY.

documents.title: The definition of a reradiated field
documents.text: A reradiated field is an electromagnetic field resulting from currents induced in a secondary conducting object when electromagnetic waves are incident on that object.

documents.title: In the passive scanning procedure, the station sweeps from channel to channel
documents.text: In the passive scanning procedure, the station sweeps from channel to channel and records information from any Beacons it receives.

documents.title: A non-DMG STA that receives a CF-End frame resets its NAV and
documents.text: A non-DMG STA that receives a CF-End frame resets its NAV and can start contending for the medium without further delay.

documents.title: TsteeringWLAN specifies the timer value during which the rules for traffic steering
documents.text: 3GPP TS 36.304 specifies that tsteeringWLAN specifies the timer value during which the rules for traffic steering between E-UTRAN and WLAN should be fulfilled.

documents.title: Definition of the acronym PKI
documents.text: PKI stands for Public Key Infrastructure.

documents.title: Definition of TSC
documents.text: TSC stands for Time-Sensitive Communication in the context of integration with IEEE TSN.

documents.title: A UE supports a secure mechanism for the home operator to disallow
documents.text: A UE supports a secure mechanism for the home operator to disallow selection of one or more of its radio technologies, regardless of PLMNs.

documents.title: Under high network load conditions, the network may protect itself by using
documents.text: Under high network load conditions, the network may protect itself by using Unified Access Control functionality to limit access attempts from UEs.

documents.title: Inter-PLMN accounts for roaming traffic are determined in accordance with ITU-T principles
documents.text: Inter-PLMN accounts for roaming traffic are determined in accordance with ITU-T principles and settled by means of the GSM Association's Transferred Account Procedure (TAP).

documents.title: The NWDAF collects input information for PDU Session traffic analytics by subscribing
documents.text: The NWDAF collects input information for PDU Session traffic analytics by subscribing to UPF event exposure and collecting data indirectly via the SMF or directly from the UPF.

documents.title: Power saving scheme can potentially reduce the UE power consumption by reducing the number of PDCCH blind decoding
documents.text: PDCCH skipping can potentially reduce the UE power consumption by reducing the number of PDCCH blind decoding.

documents.title: The slot time in the DS PHY is 20µs
documents.text: The slot time in the DS PHY is 20µs.

documents.title: Hopping sequences in frequency hopping systems
documents.text: Hopping sequences in frequency hopping systems refer to sequences of frequency slots in which transmissions occur.

documents.title: Purpose of a flexible and dynamic allocation of radio resources between unicast and multicast services within the network
documents.text: A flexible and dynamic allocation of radio resources between unicast and multicast services allows for efficient delivery of real-time and streaming multicast/broadcast content over wide geographic areas.

documents.title: The LTE Measurement Gap Enhancement work item specifies LTE measurement gap configurations
documents.text: The LTE Measurement Gap Enhancement work item specifies LTE measurement gap configurations with shorter measurement gap length (MGL=3ms).

documents.title: The demodulation enhancement feature in LTE enables the UE to handle the
documents.text: The demodulation enhancement feature in LTE enables the UE to handle the Doppler shift issue in SFN scenario caused by opposite Doppler shifts associated with separate paths on the UE.

documents.title: When the BWP inactivity timer expires, the UE switches to the default
documents.text: When the BWP inactivity timer expires, the UE switches to the default BWP.

documents.title: Purpose of the Wake-up signalling feature in NB-IoT
documents.text: The Wake-up signalling feature allows the eNB to send the UE a wake-up signal to instruct the UE to monitor NPDCCH for paging, and otherwise allows the UE to skip the paging procedures. This helps to reduce UE power consumption.

documents.title: An active scan is initiated using a Beacon Request command
documents.text: An active scan is initiated using a Beacon Request command.

documents.title: The common charging architecture provides only a common logical view of charging
documents.text: The common charging architecture provides only a common logical view of charging functions.

documents.title: Purpose of the 'Echo request/reply' message in ICMP
documents.text: The 'Echo request/reply' message in ICMP is used to request a reply from the destination host. The reply contains the same data as the request.

documents.title: The NFV management and orchestration capabilities that can be leveraged for applying energy efficiency policies
documents.text: NFV management and orchestration capabilities can be used to adjust power states of NFVI resources and optimize VNF/NS placement based on power consumption savings.

documents.title: The Connection Resume procedure is used by a UE when it is
documents.text: The Connection Resume procedure is used by a UE when it is in CM-CONNECTED with RRC_INACTIVE state and upper layers or the AS requests the resumption of a suspended RRC connection.

documents.title: Definition of CFI
documents.text: The document states that CFI stands for Control Format Indicator which indicates how many OFDM symbols are used for the Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH).

documents.title: The role of the supplicant in the 802.1x authentication architecture
documents.text: The supplicant is the end user machine that seeks access to network resources in the 802.1x authentication architecture.

documents.title: Definition of the term BSS
documents.text: BSS stands for Basic Service Set, which refers to a group of stations that communicate with each other in an 802.11 network.

documents.title: Purpose of segmentation of RRC messages
documents.text: The purpose of segmentation of RRC messages is to reduce the size of encoded RRC messages.

documents.title: Entity controls network resources through the E2 interface
documents.text: The Near-RT RIC controls network resources through the E2 interface.

documents.title: Methodology was selected as the reference methodology for MIMO OTA testing in LTE
documents.text: The multi-probe anechoic chamber (MPAC) methodology was selected as the reference methodology for MIMO OTA testing in LTE.

documents.title: If a location request fails due to barring, an error cause is
documents.text: If a location request fails due to barring, an error cause is returned to the LCS Requestor.

documents.title: The duration of radio frame structure type 1
documents.text: 3GPP TS 38.211 specifies that the duration of radio frame structure type 1 is 10ms.

documents.title: The receiver sensitivity requirement for a compliant device
documents.text: A compliant device shall be capable of achieving a receiver sensitivity of -85 dBm or better for the modulation format corresponding to the lowest data rate in the given operating band.

documents.title: Documents specify the information to be pre-configured or stored in USIM for Disaster Roaming service
documents.text: The information to be pre-configured or stored in USIM for Disaster Roaming service is specified in TS 31.102 and TS 31.111.

documents.title: The behavior of a half-duplex UE (HD-UE) in paired spectrum with regards to simultaneous transmissions and receptions
documents.text: A half-duplex UE (HD-UE) in paired spectrum is not capable of simultaneous transmissions and receptions on a serving cell with paired spectrum.

documents.title: The duration of a frame
documents.text: Each frame is divided into two equally-sized half-frames of five subframes each, with a duration of 10 ms.

documents.title: Considering that the IoT system is resource-constrained, lightweight secrecy strategies need to
documents.text: Considering that the IoT system is resource-constrained, lightweight secrecy strategies need to be adopted.

documents.title: A DMG STA should transition to listening mode not less than aDMGPPMinListeningTime
documents.text: A DMG STA should transition to listening mode not less than aDMGPPMinListeningTime before attempting to create a DMG protected period.

documents.title: The UE generates HARQ-ACK information with ACK value when it correctly decodes
documents.text: The UE generates HARQ-ACK information with ACK value when it correctly decodes a transport block.

documents.title: Purpose of the window mechanism in TCP for achieving reliability
documents.text: The window mechanism in TCP allows the sender and receiver to control the flow of data by specifying the size of the buffer and sending window advertisements.

documents.title: Purpose of cyber-physical control applications in vertical domains
documents.text: The purpose of cyber-physical control applications in vertical domains is to control physical processes over a network using algorithms. This is stated in the document summary.

documents.title: The definition of overexposure
documents.text: Overexposure refers to exposure that exceeds the applicable dosimetric reference limits defined in the standard.

documents.title: The Duration/ID field value in a BlockAckReq frame
documents.text: The Duration/ID field is set to the estimated time required to transmit one Ack or BlockAck frame, as applicable, plus one SIFS, in a BlockAckReq frame.

documents.title: The cryptographic algorithm used for integrity checks in WEP
documents.text: WEP uses a cyclic redundancy check (CRC) algorithm for integrity checks, which is not cryptographically secure.

documents.title: Definition of let-go current
documents.text: Let-go current refers to the current level above which involuntary muscular contraction prevents release of a grip on an energized conductor.

documents.title: PDCP packet duplication in LTE allows sending the same PDCP Protocol Data
documents.text: PDCP packet duplication in LTE allows sending the same PDCP Protocol Data Unit (PDU) on two independent transmission paths to increase reliability.

documents.title: Purpose of fraud and cost control mechanisms in the context of roaming agreements
documents.text: Fraud and cost control mechanisms are used to ensure that charges incurred for 3GPP services do not exceed the credit limits set.

documents.title: The security aspects on the UE authentication during the authentication procedure are
documents.text: The security aspects on the UE authentication during the authentication procedure are specified in TS 33.501.

documents.title: Purpose of the Preamble in the DS PLCP framing
documents.text: The Preamble in the DS PLCP framing is used to synchronize the transmitter and receiver.

documents.title: Purpose of the Ack frame in the control response context
documents.text: The Ack frame in the control response context is used to acknowledge the reception of a single MSDU or A-MSDU in sequentially increasing sequence number order.

documents.title: Identity is used to control the power of SRS
documents.text: TPC-SRS-RNTI is used to control the power of SRS.

documents.title: The SI unit for incident power density
documents.text: The SI unit for incident power density is watt per square meter (W/m2).

documents.title: Purpose of redundant transmission for high reliability communication in URLLC
documents.text: Redundant transmission in URLLC is used to set up two redundant PDU Sessions over the 5G network, with independent user plane paths, to enhance reliability.

documents.title: Purpose of the high-speed interface between the UICC and the ME
documents.text: The high-speed interface allows fast access and retrieval of data from the UICC.

documents.title: The physical layer interfaces the MAC sub-layer of Layer 2 in the
documents.text: The physical layer interfaces the MAC sub-layer of Layer 2 in the LTE radio interface protocol architecture.

documents.title: A UE configured for operation in bandwidth parts (BWPs) receives parameter configurations
documents.text: A UE configured for operation in bandwidth parts (BWPs) receives parameter configurations for DL and UL BWPs from higher layers.

documents.title: The function of the DeNB in the architecture supporting RNs
documents.text: The DeNB provides S1 and X2 proxy functionality between the RN and other network nodes.

documents.title: Physical channels are defined in the downlink
documents.text: The physical channels defined in the downlink are PDSCH, PMCH, PBCH.

documents.title: The three typical traffic classes or communication patterns in industrial environments
documents.text: 3GPP TS 22.104 specifies that the three typical traffic classes or communication patterns in industrial environments are deterministic periodic communication, deterministic aperiodic communication, and non-deterministic communication.

documents.title: MMS shall be capable of supporting integration of different types of messaging
documents.text: MMS shall be capable of supporting integration of different types of messaging in a consistent manner.

documents.title: The UE shall immediately report a change of its 3GPP PS Data
documents.text: 3GPP TS 24.501 specifies that the UE shall immediately report a change of its 3GPP PS Data Off status in PCO by using the UE requested PDU Session Modification procedure.

documents.title: Sublayer is responsible for routing and next-hop determination on the backhaul link
documents.text: The BAP sublayer is responsible for routing and next-hop determination on the backhaul link.

documents.title: Purpose of remote identification for UAS (unmanned aircraft system) nodes
documents.text: Remote identification is done to provide identification and regular presence updates to the control towers and airspace management system.

documents.title: An AP sets the More Data subfield to 1 in Ack frames
documents.text: An AP sets the More Data subfield to 1 in Ack frames sent to a non-DMG and non-S1G STA when it has a pending transmission for the STA.

documents.title: Spread-spectrum technique encodes a portion of the signal across each subchannel in parallel
documents.text: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) divides the available channel into several subchannels and encodes a portion of the signal across each subchannel in parallel.

documents.title: The minimum receiver sensitivity requirement for an RS-GFSK receiver
documents.text: The minimum receiver sensitivity requirement for an RS-GFSK receiver is -85 dBm.

documents.title: The 3GPP system should support clock synchronization defined by IEEE 802.1AS across
documents.text: The 3GPP system should support clock synchronization defined by IEEE 802.1AS across 5G-based Ethernet links with PDU-session type Ethernet.

documents.title: The redundancy version number used for the initial transmission or autonomous retransmission of an initial transport block for a PUSCH transmission
documents.text: 3GPP TS 38.214 specifies that the redundancy version number used for the initial transmission or autonomous retransmission of an initial transport block for a PUSCH transmission is 0.

documents.title: IPv6 addresses are represented using 128 bits
documents.text: IPv6 addresses are represented using 128 bits.

documents.title: The AMF load re-balancing functionality allows the movement of subscribers registered on
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.501 specifies that the AMF load re-balancing functionality allows the movement of subscribers registered on an AMF to another AMF within the same AMF set with minimal impacts on the network and end users.

documents.title: DBPSK
documents.text: Differential binary phase shift keying (DBPSK) is a form of differential phase shift keying encoding.

documents.title: Purpose of the PLCP header in 802.11b
documents.text: The PLCP header in 802.11b is used to indicate the speed and transmission method of the enclosed frame.

documents.title: The supported service type for QoE Measurement Collection
documents.text: 3GPP TS 26.247 specifies that the supported service types for QoE Measurement Collection are QoE Measurement Collection for DASH streaming services, QoE Measurement Collection for MTSI services, and QoE Measurement Collection for VR services.

documents.title: Work Item targets inter-cell interference cancellation in LTE
documents.text: The Network-Assisted Interference Cancellation and Suppression (NAICS) Work Item is specifically designed to address inter-cell interference cancellation in LTE.

documents.title: The PS Data Off status for a PDU Session does not affect
documents.text: The PS Data Off status for a PDU Session does not affect data transfer over non-3GPP access.

documents.title: The Notification Control parameter indicates whether notifications are requested when the GFBR
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.501 specifies that the Notification Control parameter indicates whether notifications are requested when the GFBR can no longer be fulfilled for a QoS flow.

documents.title: Of the following principles apply when 5GS assists AI/ML operations in the application layer
documents.text: 3GPP TS 23.288 specifies that all of the mentioned principles apply when 5GS assists AI/ML operations in the application layer. AF requests to the 5G System need authorization from the 5GC, application AI/ML decisions reside at the AF and UE application client, and AF can decide when to request assistance from 5GC.

documents.title: IEEE802 standard is responsible for Bluetooth
documents.text: The IEEE802.15.1 Bluetooth standard is responsible for Bluetooth.

documents.title: Sub-carrier spacing is supported by LTE-V2X (Vehicle to everything) in SL (Sidelink)
documents.text: LTE-V2X only supports 15 kHz sub-carrier spacing in SL.

documents.title: Of the following is NOT a type of V2X application
documents.text: The four types of V2X applications are Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V), Vehicle-to-Infrastructure (V2I), Vehicle-to-Network (V2N), and Vehicle-to-Pedestrian (V2P).

documents.title: The SUPI and S-NSSAI are used to determine which NF instances (AMF
documents.text: The SUPI and S-NSSAI are used to determine which NF instances (AMF and SMF) are serving a specific UE.

documents.title: An S1G STA can transmit a frame with CH_BANDWIDTH set to CBW2
documents.text: An S1G STA can transmit a frame with CH_BANDWIDTH set to CBW2 and GI_TYPE set to SHORT_GI only if the Short GI for 2 MHz subfield of the S1G Capabilities element is 1 and dot11ShortGIOptionIn2MActivated is true.

documents.title: The correlation function used to describe the autocorrelation of shadow fading
documents.text: The autocorrelation of shadow fading is described by an exponential function.

documents.title: The range of frequencies for the transmitter spurious emission limits
documents.text: The transmitter spurious emission limits shall apply from 30 MHz to the fifth harmonic of the upper frequency edge of the DL operating band, excluding the frequency range from ΔfOBUE below the lowest frequency of each supported downlink operating band, up to ΔfOBUE above the highest frequency of each supported downlink operating band.

documents.title: Specification defines the overall 5GS Stage 2
documents.text: TS 23.501 specifies the overall 5GS Stage 2, including the architecture reference model and high-level functions.

documents.title: The wake-up signal is used to wake up NB-IoT devices and is
documents.text: The wake-up signal is used to wake up NB-IoT devices and is transmitted over 2 physical resource blocks in the frequency domain in available symbols of configured subframes.

documents.title: Purpose of the RedCap UE type
documents.text: The RedCap UE type enables reduced UE complexity and power consumption for IoT use cases with low data rate requirements.

documents.title: Purpose of standardising service capabilities
documents.text: Standardising service capabilities can reduce the complexity of introducing new services or modifying existing ones across different operators' networks.

documents.title: The 5G Data Connectivity domain charging relies on the generic converged charging
documents.text: The 5G Data Connectivity domain charging relies on the generic converged charging architecture.

documents.title: The Scheduling request feature allows a connected mode UE to send a
documents.text: The Scheduling request feature allows a connected mode UE to send a request to the eNB to be granted NPUSCH resources to send a buffer status report (BSR).

documents.title: Used to carry HARQ feedback over the sidelink
documents.text: The Physical Sidelink Feedback Channel (PSFCH) carries HARQ feedback over the sidelink.

documents.title: Definition of EARFCN
documents.text: EARFCN stands for E-UTRA Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number.

documents.title: Definition of PDR
documents.text: PDR stands for Packet Delivery Ratio.

documents.title: The granularity of the time reference provided by the network to end user equipment in LTE
documents.text: The time reference provided by the network to end user equipment in LTE has a granularity of 0.25 microseconds.

documents.title: Purpose of the SDAP sublayer in Layer 2
documents.text: The main purpose of the SDAP sublayer is to mark the QoS flow ID (QFI) in both DL and UL packets.

documents.title: IEEE standard introduced Power over Ethernet
documents.text: IEEE802.3af introduced Power over Ethernet.

documents.title: The subcarrier spacing in the 802.11a standard for OFDM
documents.text: The subcarrier spacing in the 802.11a standard for OFDM is 0.3125 MHz, which is the inverse of the FFT integration time.

documents.title: GMRP used for
documents.text: GMRP (GARP Multicast Registration Protocol) is used to filter multicast messages in Layer 2-based networks.

documents.title: The maximum data rate of Gigabit Ethernet
documents.text: Gigabit Ethernet targets a data rate of 1Gbps.

documents.title: Purpose of user data congestion analytics
documents.text: User data congestion analytics provide statistics or predictions, or both, related to congestion experienced while transferring user data.

documents.title: If an MPDU is received and no MSDU with the same sequence
documents.text: If an MPDU is received and no MSDU with the same sequence number is already present in the buffer, the MPDU should be stored in the buffer.
